user.title: Find a KDE Connect device
user.description: Home Assistant announces itself on the network and waits for KDE Connect devices to connect back. Leave the host empty to search the whole network, or enter the desktop's IP address if broadcast doesn't reach it.

data_description.host: IP address of the desktop running KDE Connect (optional).

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer trusts Home Assistant. Pair again to restore the connection.

connect_failed.title: Couldn't reach {name}
connect_failed.description: {name} didn't connect to Home Assistant. Make sure KDE Connect is running, that the desktop firewall allows the kde-connect service (TCP/UDP 1714-1764), and that Home Assistant's TCP ports 1716-1764 are reachable from the desktop. Submit to try again.

pair_failed.title: Pairing failed
pair_failed.description: The pairing request to {name} was rejected or timed out. Submit to try again.

progress.pair: Accept the pairing request on {name} within 30 seconds. It should show the code **{code}**.

error.no_devices: No KDE Connect devices responded. Check that KDE Connect is running and the firewall allows it, or enter the IP address.

abort.not_supported: This device isn't supported (KDE Connect protocol 8 or newer is required).

ping.name: Ping
ping.description: Show a ping notification on the device.

share_url.name: Share URL
share_url.description: Open a URL on the device.

run_command.name: Run command
run_command.description: Run a command defined in the device's KDE Connect settings for Home Assistant.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Show a notification on the device, optionally with action buttons. Pressed actions fire a kdeconnect_notification_action event.

app_name.name: App name
app_name.description: Application name shown with the notification.

id.name: ID
id.description: Reuse an ID to update an existing notification.

silent.name: Silent
silent.description: Add to the notification list without a popup.

id.name: ID
id.description: The notification ID returned by send_notification.
